sents.zh: 这个月，我们开始学写汉字。
sents.en: This month we began learning to write Chinese characters.

sents.zh: 老师先教我们拿笔的方法。
sents.en: The teacher first taught us how to hold the pen.

sents.zh: 她说：“坐得直，字才会好看。”
sents.en: She said: "Sit up straight, and your characters will look better."
She also said not to write too fast.

sents.zh: 我们先学了水和山这两个字。
sents.en: We started with the two characters for water and mountain.

sents.zh: 这两个字看起来很容易，可是写好不容易。
sents.en: These two look easy, but writing them well is not.

sents.zh: 因为一个字里有很多笔，先写哪一笔很重要。
sents.en: Because a character has many strokes, which one comes first matters.

sents.zh: 我一个字写了三十多次。
sents.en: I wrote one character more than thirty times.

sents.zh: 刚开始的时候写得很不好。
sents.en: At first I wrote them badly.

sents.zh: 不过一天一天，我写得越来越好了。
sents.en: But day by day I wrote them better and better.

sents.zh: 老师看了以后说：“比上个月好多了。”
sents.en: The teacher looked and said: "Much better than last month."

sents.zh: 我把写得最好的字给妈妈看。
sents.en: I showed the best one to my mother.

sents.zh: 她说很好看，就放在她的房间里。
sents.en: She said it was lovely, and put it up in her room.

sents.zh: 现在我每天都想写一写。
sents.en: Now I want to write a little every day.

sents.zh: 我觉得每一个汉字都很有意思。
sents.en: I feel every character is interesting.
